title: Ethanol Precipitation of Small DNA Fragments
author: Eva Petrova

steps.title: Transfer sample to tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the DNA sample into a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Adjust salt concentrations
steps.instruction: Adjust the sample to 0.3 M sodium acetate and 0.01 M MgCl₂.

steps.title: Add Pellet Paint NF
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL Pellet Paint NF (co‑precipitant, catalog #70748‑3) to the tube.

steps.title: Add carrier DNA
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL non‑labeled E. coli genomic DNA as a carrier to increase precipitation yield.

steps.title: Add cold absolute ethanol
steps.instruction: Add two volumes of cold absolute ethanol to the sample.

steps.title: Incubate at –80 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture for 2–3 hours at –80 °C (critical for small fragments).

steps.title: Centrifuge pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed (≥10 000 g) for 30 minutes at 0 °C.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully discard the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Wash pellet with 70 % ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 750–1000 µL cold 70 % ethanol, invert the tube several times to wash the pellet.

steps.title: Centrifuge after wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed (≥10 000 g) for 30 minutes at 0 °C.

steps.title: Repeat wash and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Repeat the washing step (add 750–1000 µL cold 70 % ethanol, invert) and centrifugation (30 min, 0 °C, ≥10 000 g) once more.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final pellet in an appropriate volume of de‑ionized H₂O.
